Clockwork_Prehensile_Cables.description: Sinister clockwork tentacles, prehensile and finely crafted with intricate gears and springs, coil and uncoil with mechanical precision, granting their construct host unparalleled dexterity and reach, enabling them to scale sheer surfaces and ensnare foes with ease.

Heavy_Iron_Whip_Tentacles.description: These formidable tentacles, forged from darkened iron and animated by arcane forces, extend from the construct's bulk, each segment heavy with mass and strength, granting it the power to tear through armor and send foes sprawling with a single strike.

Steam_Hose_Scalding_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the steam-choked depths, the Steam_Hose_Scalding_Tentacles are serpentine appendages of a construct, their metallic tendrils hissing with scalding steam, capable of both grapples and emitting a searing aura, while their reach extends menacingly beyond their mechanical frame.

Crystal_Prism_Resonance_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the crystalline depths of an ancient, arcane construct, the Crystal Prism Resonance Tentacles shimmer with prismatic light, their serpentine forms twisting and bending with otherworldly grace, capable of reflecting spells back upon their caster while bathing allies in purifying light.

Necrotic_Stitched_Intestine_Tentacles.description: These writhing Necrotic Stitched Intestine Tentacles, pulsating with dark energy, are ghastly appendages that trail behind a twisted construct, their very presence sapping the vigor of the living and poisoning the air with a noxious cloud.

Living_Wood_Thorny_Vines.description: Entangled within the gnarled limbs of ancient trees, Living Wood Thorny Vines are a twisted amalgamation of bark and bone, their writhing, thorny appendages capable of scaling sheer surfaces with prehensile dexterity, while their razor-sharp thorns spill life from any unlucky prey caught in their grasp.

Scrap_Metal_Chain_Link_Tentacles.description: Gnarled scrap metal tentacles, forged from the twisted remnants of forgotten machinery, extend from the construct's body, granting it an eerie reach and formidable strength, while also bestowing it the ability to grapple, sunder, and scale sheer surfaces with preternatural ease.

Mithril_Filigree_Whip_Tentacles.description: Enveloped in a sheen of cold, metallic grace, the Mithril Filigree Whip Tentacles are serpentine appendages that shimmer with a predatory elegance, their fluid movements granting unparalleled agility and speed to their wielder, while the inherent metallic nature of the tentacles allows for devastating bleed attacks.

Porcelain_Doll_Ribbon_Tentacles.description: The porcelain doll ribbon tentacles are delicate yet eerie appendages, crafted from fine ceramic and adorned with intricate patterns, weaving through the air with a haunting grace that both fascinates and terrifies, enhancing the charm and charisma of their bearer while subtly diminishing their physical prowess.

Arcane_Energy_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths, the Arcane Energy Tendrils are ghostly appendages that shimmer with arcane energy, their serpentine forms granting both wisdom and an extended reach, allowing them to ensnare foes and reflect hostile spells back at their origin.
